Whenever you deal Sneak Attack damage, you can give up two of those dice to instead land a lethal strike. Several lethal strikes call for a saving throw with a DC equal to 8 plus your proficiency bonus plus your Dexterity modifier.

Priming Attack. The target attempts a Dexterity, Constitution, or Wisdom save (your choice). On a failure, the next time you deal Sneak Attack damage to it before the end of your following turn, you roll four bonus Sneak Attack dice.

Target Assessment. The target attempts a Charisma save. On a failure, the GM reveals two details of your choosing from this list: its highest ability score, its lowest ability score, its strongest saving throw, or its weakest saving throw.

Vulnerable Strike. The target attempts a Wisdom save. On a failure, the next attack roll you would make against it before the end of your following turn is instead replaced with a saving throw of an ability you choose; if the target fails that save, it takes ordinary weapon damage, suffers any effects that normally trigger on a hit, and you may add Sneak Attack damage to the result.
